full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph frames two young children closely together beside a dark window at night. The child on the left has tousled light hair and wears a pale short-sleeved shirt. Their face is turned toward the camera with a serious, fixed gaze, one arm bent near the lower edge. The child on the right has shorter, lighter curls and a sleeveless pale top. Their head rests near the first child's shoulder, eyes widened and looking a little off to the right. Both faces are softly lit and occupy most of the lower-right half of the composition. Behind them, the window glass is nearly black, reflecting a bright blurred light and faint interior shapes. A dark vertical frame divides the background, and a narrow bright strip along the lower edge suggests a sill or seat. The children are pressed close, their white clothing forming a single broad light shape against the surrounding dark. The photograph uses a near eye-level viewpoint and a tight crop, allowing small differences in expression to carry the moment. Illumination appears to come from a soft source in front or above them; it catches the curls, round cheeks, and eyes while leaving the window and room in deep shadow. Film grain, slight softness, and high contrast make the image feel like an observed instant rather than a posed studio picture. No clear action is visible beyond their quiet proximity and attentive looking. The composition holds an intimate pair of faces against a mysterious nighttime reflection, balancing the children's pale forms with the large area of black glass.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白照片近距离框住夜晚暗窗旁紧挨着的两名年幼孩子。左边孩子头发浅而蓬乱，穿浅色短袖衫。脸朝镜头，有认真而固定的目光，一只手臂在下边缘附近弯起。右边孩子有更短、更浅的卷发，穿浅色无袖上衣。头靠近第一人的肩，眼睛睁大，略向右边望。两张面孔受到柔光照亮，占据构图右下大半。身后窗玻璃几乎全黑，反射一个模糊亮点和隐约室内形状。深色竖框分开背景，下缘一条窄亮带暗示窗台或座位。孩子们贴在一起，白衣在周围黑暗前组成一大块浅亮形状。照片使用近似视线同高机位与紧密裁切，让表情的细小差别承载这一刻。光似乎来自前方或上方柔光，照到卷发、圆脸颊和眼睛，却让窗与房间留在深阴影中。胶片颗粒、轻微柔焦和高反差令图像像被观察到的瞬间，而非影棚摆拍。除彼此靠近和专注张望之外，没有明确动作。构图把一对亲密面孔放在神秘的夜间反光前，以孩子的浅色形体平衡大块黑色玻璃。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white candid photography centers two closely grouped light forms against a deep, reflective night ground. Soft frontal or overhead light catches hair texture, cheeks, and eyes, while glass and interior detail stay mostly black. Use a tight eye-level crop, high contrast, subtle grain, and slightly softened edges. Let differing gazes and small expressions supply emotional movement, supported by a few blurred reflected lights. The composition should feel immediate and intimate, with natural proximity and a large dark area that gives the lit forms room to stand out.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白随拍摄影把两块紧贴的浅色形体放在深色、带反光的夜间背景前。柔和正面或上方光照到头发质地、脸颊与眼睛，玻璃和室内细节大多保持黑暗。使用视线同高的紧密裁切、高反差、细颗粒和略柔边缘。不同视线和细小表情提供情绪运动，少数模糊倒光辅助。构图应直接而亲密，以自然靠近和大片暗区衬托受光形体。
theme_en: Two young children leaning together beside a dark window at night
theme_zh: 两名年幼孩子在夜色暗窗旁相互倚靠
name: Bill Eppridge
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
